selection_independence: Outside targeted chapter4 mechanism-development records; same prior synthetic catalog, not blind or IID
input_origin: Unmodified config_v01.json original base condition, R2/R5 samples; fresh_input auto-L adapter identical to development

frozen_rules.HEFT: Original complete HEFT including its existing energy pass, 300s single root
frozen_rules.OFF_ON: Same original HEFT initialization, activity targets, primary pairs, templates, ranking, legality and complete evaluator; only allow_blocking_edges differs
frozen_rules.original_legal_choices: All original device and OPP choices retained at input/initialization; refinement fixed-unit scope remains an algorithm limitation, never a model mask
frozen_rules.initialization: Fresh independent per slot; charge imports, input, initializer, sorting and all evaluations to one root; no historical warm start or shared caches
frozen_rules.strict_acceptance: Full SAFE and new.upper < incumbent.lower; no worse intermediate incumbent
frozen_rules.matching: Compare completed best-initial semantic candidate, interval and initialization candidate order; mismatch/incomplete restricts attribution and never triggers a free rerun
frozen_rules.metrics: Per-case SAFE feasibility/status, full weighted energy intervals, component energies, end-to-end and refinement times, first SAFE/improvement, complete evaluator/cache counts; missing/invalid is not zero energy
frozen_rules.post: At most one fresh <=60s recomputation on original final candidate, same evaluator; label as process-independent rerun, not an independent numerical implementation
frozen_rules.outcomes: Retain all no-gain, unresolved, initialization mismatch, slower, worse-than-HEFT and missing-SAFE outcomes; no case replacement or favorable-only aggregate
frozen_rules.stops: No retries/refunds or parameter tuning; technical/numerical/source/identity/post failure stops later slots; normal no-SAFE may continue as an explicit outcome
frozen_rules.no_formal_claim: Two cases once each cannot prove statistical robustness, external generalization, active thermal constraints or optimality

prerequisites_before_any_run: Separate explicit authorization of this six-slot budget
Fresh frozen source/environment identities and dedicated inert-to-active admission reviewed
All launcher and complete evidence gates passing
No reuse of old claims or authorizations
